462: The general theme of this challenge is position check. There are several bosses in this challenge that has a position check mechanic, where your damage will be reduced by 95% if you are outside of the boss' barrier.
463: This challenge episode heavily favors melee heroes, especially melee heroes that are capable of dashing. Do not expect ranged heroes without sufficient burst to be rated highly here, as it is hard for you to stay reliably within the boss' barrier as to be able to deal any damage. Not only that, all of the bosses in EP4 challenge hits extremely hard, especially the hidden bosses; choose your options wisely, or you'll die.
464: If you are using a ranged team, it is suggested to run WoG on one your priests, or at least some form of dispel, as the position check mechanics are dispellable buffs that are reapplied at certain intervals. With dispel, the barrier mechanic can be partially bypassed, allowing consistent damage type ranged DPSes to kill these bosses. We are also clasifying the new challenge stages as endgame+ since you need to have high investments in terms of raw stats to even survive the stages and the fact that there isnt a team that clears 100% of the time that has decent times.
